Name: Teleportation Tool
Author: Vladislavjzk
Description:
[b][size=5]Compatible with Stardew Valley v1.6![/size][/b]
[size=3]Tired of walking forever, and it's hard to manage your time? Or you want to teleport to inaccessible places?
Using a teleportation tool, you can teleport to your cursor.
You can buy it from [b]Krobus [/b]for 1 million gold.
Also, for 2 million gold you can purchase the improved [b]Galaxy[/b] Teleportation Tool, which allows you to teleport instantly.[/size]

[b][size=4]Installation & Usage:[/size][/b][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Download the zipped file, and unzip its full contents into your Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.[/size]
[/list]
